$comment: 내일 방문 예정 — tomorrow's registration count in KST, from the SAME history read that feeds iparking_today_count, so it costs no extra request. Same two filters as today's count: CANCEL rows are excluded (취소 flips inot_status rather than deleting the row), and the date is re-checked client-side because the vendor's own filtering was never characterised. `insights: true` for the same reason today's count has it — a count per day is a real measurement, unlike the constant string this tile used to carry.
